summary: The MaintCampus application is a user interface component designed to manage campus-related data within the HSPnet system. It includes functionality for adding, editing, deleting, and reactivating campus entries. The system is designed using ASP.NET Web Forms with various server controls, including GridView and DetailsView for data display and interaction.
purpose: The purpose of the MaintCampus application is to provide an interface for managing campus information, allowing users with appropriate permissions to view, add, edit, delete, or reactivate campus records. The application ensures data integrity and user access control.

workflows.name: Modify Campus Data
steps: Display current list of campuses in gridData.
Handle gridData_RowCommand for adding, editing, deleting, or reactivating entries.
Update data in response to user actions.
Display details in dvwDetail for editing.

business_rules: Only users with appropriate permissions can modify data.
ScreenIsEditable is determined by user session and agency ID.
validations: Name and ShortName fields are required.
Input values are validated before saving.
conditions: If not IsPostBack, initialize dropdowns and focus on agency selection.
Reactivate button appears only for inactive campuses.
Delete button appears only for active campuses.
system_behavior: The system retrieves and binds data to gridData and dvwDetail upon page load and data changes.
Error and warning messages are displayed using pnlError and pnlWarning.
dependencies: Agencies and Departments data sources for dropdowns.
exceptions: Handle null entries when editing non-existent campuses.
